title: registerCatalogBlocks' import-order comment names two packages that do not claim bare `chart`
body:
Found while taking the bare-key census for objectui#6416 (report-only there, so filed separately, unassigned).

## The fact

`apps/site/app/components/registerCatalogBlocks.ts:139` justifies its import order with a claimant list that names two packages which do not claim the key:

```
 * IMPORT ORDER IS CONTRACT. Several packages register the same bare keyword
 * (`chart` is claimed by plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard and plugin-report;
 * `calendar` by plugin-calendar over `@object-ui/components`' `ui:calendar`),
 * and the last registration of a key wins.
```

Re-derived from source with the repo's own `deriveRegistryKeys`
(`scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`), which is what feeds the CLI whitelist and judges doc snippets:

```
chart     <- apps/console/src/preview-gallery.tsx:42 ,
             apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts:71 ,
             packages/plugin-charts/src/index.tsx:88
dashboard <- apps/console/src/preview-gallery.tsx:36 ,
             apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts:65 ,
             packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx:79
```

Among packages, bare `chart` is claimed by **`plugin-charts` alone**. The two console sites are lazy stubs that load `plugin-charts`. Neither `plugin-dashboard` nor `plugin-report` registers a bare `chart` key at all — `plugin-report` registers only `report`, `spec-report` and `report-viewer` (all three under `plugin-report` after objectui#6416).

## Why it is worth recording

The comment is not decoration: it is the stated reason the import order in that file is a contract, and the sentence that tells the next editor which packages are in the fight. A reader who trusts it will reason about `plugin-dashboard` / `plugin-report` ordering that cannot matter, and may miss that the real single claimant makes the `chart` half of the justification vacuous.

Nothing renders differently — the two pins the comment names (`examples/schema-catalog/test/plugin-dashboard-gallery-render.test.tsx` and `catalog-gallery-render.test.tsx`) still guard the list itself, and `check:doc-types` is green. This is stale prose, not a behaviour bug.

## Reproduce

```
sed -n '138,143p' apps/site/app/components/registerCatalogBlocks.ts
node -e "import('./scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs').then(m=>{
  const {keys}=m.deriveRegistryKeys(process.cwd());
  console.log('chart <-', (keys.get('chart')||[]).join(' , '));
})"
```

## Not decided here

Whether the fix is to correct the claimant list to the measured one, or to drop the parenthetical and keep only the `calendar` example (which the same derivation confirms is real), or to derive the sentence from a pin so it cannot drift again. The `calendar` half of the claim was not re-checked in depth beyond confirming `plugin-calendar` and `ui:calendar` both exist.

Related: objectui#6416 (the census this came out of), objectui#5106 (the doc-types gate never judges the namespace half of a registration row).
